answer: In an oasis market for pearl jewelry and lantern oil, allocate dispute-jury influence by escrowed stake rather than agent identities. Count each locked unit once across the ledger, with no base votes for opening an account. Dividing a deposit among aliases cannot increase their combined weight. Hold the stake until disputes close and slash it for verifiably false certifications. An attacker must finance additional collateral and risk losing it to gain influence.
